scenario: video node save and edit with mode-aware references
description: Confirms that the public video mode set is t2v | first_last_frame | m2v, i2v and multi_modal are rejected, and reference rules are honoured.
expectations: Public --mode values are exactly t2v, first_last_frame, m2v
--mode i2v is rejected with exit code 2 (no such mode)
--mode multi_modal is rejected with exit code 2 (server-internal alias)
first_last_frame accepts 1 or 2 image-bearing refs; two frames must match in source ratio
m2v is used for image-to-video, video guidance, Element references, and ratio preservation
Generation edit replaces the full block; --clear-generation is the opt-out
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-quote-and-run
node: and res: refs are distinguished; internal short links are rejected
